LESSON: PHYSICAL FEATURES IN THE COUNTY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Physical features in the County

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

Welcome to this lesson on Physical features in the County. In Kenyan schools, learners explore this topic to understand how it connects to daily life in our communities. A key question we explore is: 1.0 Natural and Built Environments
